result.summary: Security HARD GATE (Step 2c) for PRM-02..05 promotion pipeline: FAIL (BLOCKER). INV-1 BLOCKER empirically confirmed: promotion_reviews exists ONLY in public in bpm_test (0 RLS policies, no per-tenant copies; migration 096 applied in the public pass only), so the submit/context/approve/reject/apply paths operate on a shared un-scoped table. INV-2 BLOCKER: approve takes approved_by from the request body and discards the authenticated actor (_ = actor), so the PRM-05 separation-of-duties/self-approval gate is bypassable. MAJOR: inconsistent per-tenant event placement (REJECTED under target-tenant search_path vs APPROVED/APPLIED under request-principal context). INV-7/INV-8 clean (all SQL parameterised; no catch unreachable in the diff); zig build and all static lints exit 0. TEST-DESIGNER must not start until the BLOCKER findings are resolved and this gate re-passes.

issues.description: promotion_reviews is not tenant-isolated: migration 096 (numeric, no scope guard) ran in the public pass; in bpm_test the table exists ONLY in public, 0 RLS policies, no per-tenant copies. The PRM-02..05 review read/write paths operate on this shared un-scoped table when the request resolves via search_path=public (LEGACY_RLS / no-tenant path) — cross-tenant read/write of serialised_plan promotion diffs and review metadata. promotion_reviews is also missing from tools/lint_migration_schema.py BUSINESS_TABLES, so the linter is blind to it.

Approver identity is client-supplied: handleApproveReview discards the authenticated principal (_ = actor) and takes approved_by from the request body; the self-approval gate compares two client-supplied values, so any authenticated caller who can read a review_id can approve it by supplying any approved_by != requested_by (fabricated UUID). This bypasses the PRM-05 separation-of-duties gate; the new DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED event records the client-supplied identity as actor_id.

Inconsistent per-tenant event placement: rejectIfConflicts writes DEFINITION_PROMOTION_REJECTED under the target-tenant search_path, while approveReview/markReviewApplied write DEFINITION_PROMOTION_APPROVED/_APPLIED under the request-principal context (no switch to the review row's tenant_id). Also submitReview inserts the review row under the caller's context while stamping tenant_id = target_tenant_id — logical/physical ownership mismatch. The batch needs one explicit owner-tenant decision for review rows and promotion events, enforced on every path.

result.next_action: ORCH routes BLOCKER findings to BACKEND-DEV (fix) and ISSUE-FIXER Step 0.5 (file GitHub issues); re-route to SECURITY-REVIEWER (Step 2c) after fix. TEST-DESIGNER (Step 3) must not start until this gate returns PASS.
